value.rationale: The natural Hare quota bounds candidate approval capacity. This is an exact structural collapse of the fractional fairness hierarchy to JR over ALL committees, yields O(nm) recognition and a direct greedy construction, and a three-candidate one-over-quota family gives the sharp universal boundary. The all-q fractional/integral separation is motivated and is not simply a renaming or an arbitrary fixed-size enumeration.
